extraction.name: RoboFAC dataset
extraction.description: A large-scale dataset for robotic failure analysis and correction, comprising 9,440 erroneous manipulation trajectories and 78,623 QA pairs across 16 diverse tasks and 53 scenes in both simulation and real-world environments. It covers six types of failures across three hierarchical levels (task planning, motion planning, and execution control) with eight question types for multi-dimensional analysis.
extraction.creator: Weifeng Lu, Minghao Ye, Zewei Ye, Ruihan Tao, Shuo Yang, Bo Zhao
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Simulation data was collected for 14 robotic tasks in the ManiSkill environment using expert policies with motion planning, with failure data generated by replacing expert policies with erroneous trajectories. Real-world data was collected via teleoperation using the SO-100 robotic arm for 6 tasks. Each video was accompanied by descriptive text including failure substage, taxonomy, and detailed explanation. Manual data cleaning was performed to remove misaligned trajectories.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Manual data cleaning was performed to remove trajectories that did not align with corresponding textual descriptions, retaining approximately 75% of the collected simulation data.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Robotic failure and success video trajectories with corresponding descriptive text, collected from the ManiSkill simulation environment (augmented with YCB Object Dataset, ReplicaCAD, and AI2-THOR scenes) and real-world teleoperation. Dataset includes 8,960 simulated failure trajectories, 480 real-world failure trajectories, 1,160 simulated success trajectories, and 122 real-world success trajectories, resulting in 78K video QA samples after annotation.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Reference answers for five question types (task identification, task planning, failure detection, failure identification, failure locating) were directly extracted from textual descriptions. For three types (failure explanation, high-level correction, low-level correction), GPT-4o was used with structured prompts combining video and textual descriptions to generate answers. All GPT-4o outputs were manually reviewed and corrected.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: All GPT-4o generated annotations were manually reviewed and corrected to ensure quality.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT-4o was used to generate reference answers for failure explanation, high-level correction, and low-level correction question types, using structured prompts with video and textual description inputs.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The current integration of the RoboFAC model into VLA-controlled robotic systems is not yet seamless, and the model is applied exclusively to VLA models rather than hierarchical policies. Current robot failure datasets (including prior work) are limited to simple robotic tasks and lack comprehensive analysis.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The RoboFAC dataset is used for training and evaluating multimodal large models on robotic failure analysis and correction tasks, including Task Understanding, Failure Analysis, and Failure Correction based on robot video. It also serves as a benchmark for assessing multimodal models' capabilities in robotic failure video understanding.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Simulation data was augmented with objects from the YCB Object Dataset to increase object diversity, and scenes from ReplicaCAD and AI2-THOR to enrich environmental diversity. Failure data was generated by replacing expert policies with erroneous trajectory code snippets. Five question templates were provided per question type for variety.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Manual data cleaning was performed to remove trajectories that did not align with corresponding textual descriptions, retaining approximately 75% of collected simulation data. GPT-4o was used to generate reference answers for three question types (failure explanation, high-level correction, low-level correction), and all GPT-4o outputs were manually reviewed and corrected to ensure annotation quality.
